company.name: SCALE AI Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
company.overview: SCALE AI is an AI-first technology and digital engineering firm that builds intelligent AI tools, modern websites, mobile apps, and enterprise software for startups and global enterprises. We have delivered 250+ projects worldwide with certified quality.
company.certification: SCALE AI is ISO 9001:2015 certified for quality management and technology engineering.

process: SCALE AI describes its process as Discover, Plan, Build, and Launch. It combines strategy, design, and engineering, with regular communication and training/documentation for teams.
pricing: Project pricing depends on specific technical requirements and scope; ask the SCALE AI team for a tailored quote.
timeline: A landing page may take 2–4 weeks and a full web or mobile app typically 8–16 weeks. Timelines depend on scope; SCALE AI provides an estimate after discovery.
maintenance: SCALE AI stays with clients after go-live for fixes, updates, security patches, and the next version. Ask the team to confirm the support arrangements for a specific project.
